task: Problem 3: polarity, intensity and faithful input-deletion explanations

data.selection_and_evaluation: Attachment 2 valid; labels used for checkpoint selection and class-bias calibration, never backpropagated
data.final_prediction: Attachment 4 aligned 20 samples; unaligned files and original videos used only for evidence localization

checkpoint.encoder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, top two layers fine-tuned, dynamic int8 ONNX

input.audio_vision_standardization: training-split scaler in package; only observed frames standardized, clipped to [-5,5]

explanation.target: original predicted class biased logit, fixed for every deletion
explanation.global: delete all observed positions of one modality and re-run whole predictor
explanation.share: absolute global logit drop divided by sum of absolute drops
explanation.main: largest positive logit drop; if none, largest absolute effect with fallback flag
explanation.local: single aligned-position deletion; exhaustive joint deletion windows of 1 to 3 valid positions
explanation.interpretation: model input sensitivity; not causal attribution

media_localization.text: exact tokenizer character offsets after token-ID identity check
media_localization.audio: aligned-to-unaligned exact feature vector matching; nominal 20 Hz
media_localization.vision: aligned-to-unaligned exact feature vector matching; nominal 15 Hz; original video nominal 30 fps
media_localization.time_check: compare estimated interval to ffprobe media stream duration
media_localization.unavailable: explicit status, no fabricated timestamp or keyframe
